If you found a pet

  1. Found a dog: call the police non-emergency line, animal control or the dog warden. Pennsylvania law says a found dog goes to a licensed stray-hold kennel, where it’s held at least 48 hours so the owner can reclaim it.
  2. Ask a vet or the shelter to scan it for a microchip, then look the number up on the AAHA lookup ›
  3. Post it here and on Petco Love Lost and PawBoost.
  4. Found a cat: call Animal Protectors, or contact Kiski Valley Cat & Kitten Rescue ›
  5. Injured? AVETS in Monroeville is open 24 hours: 412-373-4200.

Sources: Find Toby in PA, AAHA, Petco Love, Animal Protectors, GuideStar, AVETS

County humane society

Humane Society of Westmoreland County. Report a lost or found pet to the county humane society and check whether it has taken the animal in.

Call 724-837-3779139 Humane Society Rd, Greensburg · Website › · Source: Network of Care

Dog licenses

Westmoreland County Treasurer, dog licenses. Buy or renew a county dog license, and call about a Westmoreland license tag on a found dog.

Call 724-830-31742 North Main St., Suite 110, Greensburg · Website › · Source: Westmoreland County

PA Dept. of Agriculture, Dog Licenses. Look up the state dog-license rules. A current license tag is one of the fastest ways to get a lost dog home.

Website › · Source: PA Dept. of Agriculture

Microchips

AAHA Universal Pet Microchip Lookup. After a vet or shelter scans a found pet, enter the chip number here to find out which registry holds the owner's contact details.

Website › · Source: AAHA

Cats

Kiski Valley Cat & Kitten Rescue. For cats: a Kiski Valley cat rescue near 15068 to ask about a found cat or kitten or to check for a lost cat.

Website › · Source: GuideStar

Another 24-hour emergency vet

BluePearl Pet Hospital Pittsburgh North (formerly Pittsburgh Veterinary Specialty & Emergency Center). A backup 24-hour emergency hospital for an injured pet if AVETS isn't an option.

Call 412-366-3400807 Camp Horne Rd, Pittsburgh · Website › · Source: BluePearl
